note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997); original in English; the alate is not recorded (imago unknown); major and minor soldiers are treated in a single section; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldiers dimorphic: major soldier body length about 8.5–9.0 mm, head capsule broadly rectangular, maximum width 0.77–0.83 of head length (to mandibular base); minor soldier body length 5.7–6.2 mm, antennae 17-segmented, mandibles slender, mandible/head length ratio 0.608–0.610. Compound eyes small, white, reduced; ocelli absent.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule pale reddish brown; antennae yellowish brown to pale brown; labrum pale brown, apex translucent; mandibles dark reddish brown, paler at the base; pronotum yellowish brown; meso- and metanotal plates paler than pronotum; legs and abdomen pale yellow. Head with a few short hairs; thorax sparsely pilose, with a few hairs on the margins and discs. Body length about 8.5–9.0 mm. Head capsule broadly rectangular, narrowed anteriorly (length to mandibular base 2.75–3.10 mm, maximum width 2.30–2.40 mm, width at mandibular base 1.48–1.55 mm); maximum width more than three-quarters of head length (0.77–0.83); sides strongly narrowed anteriorly (width at mandibular base/maximum width ratio 0.64). Fontanelle dot-like, circular, situated slightly behind the middle of the head. Compound eyes small, whitish, reduced. Ocelli absent. Antennae incomplete in the specimens examined; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2; segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3. Labrum triangular; apex translucent, broadly rounded. Mandibles short and thick, about half as long as head (length 1.43–1.45 mm, mandible/head length ratio 0.47–0.52). Left mandible with a tooth process; right mandible without a tooth process. Postmentum subquadrate, sides slightly incurved (length 1.91–1.95 mm, maximum width 0.61–0.65 mm, waist width 0.43 mm). Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped (length 0.76–0.98 mm, maximum width 1.48–1.65 mm); anterior margin distinctly concave, posterior margin weakly incised; anterolateral corners narrowly rounded; mesonotum narrower than pronotum, metanotum intermediate, posterior margin slightly incurved, lateral margins angularly broadly rounded. Minor soldier: head capsule pale reddish brown; labrum brownish, apex translucent; mandibles dark reddish brown, paler at the base; pronotum yellowish brown. Head and body sparsely pilose, but more so than in the major soldier. Body length 5.7–6.2 mm. Head capsule oval, narrowed anteriorly (length to mandibular base 1.84–2.05 mm, maximum width 1.43–1.65 mm, width at mandibular base 0.87–0.98 mm; maximum width/head length ratio 0.803–0.831, width at mandibular base/maximum width ratio 0.50–0.59). Compound eyes reduced, whitish. Ocelli absent. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 2 about 1.5 times segment 3. Labrum triangular, longer than wide; apex translucent, narrowly rounded. Mandibles long and slender (length 1.21–1.25 mm), mandible/head length ratio greater than in the major soldier (0.608–0.610). Left mandible with several tooth processes at the base. Postmentum subquadrate (length 1.17–1.22 mm, maximum width 0.46–0.51 mm), relatively wider than in the major soldier. Pronotum and other structures as in the major soldier but lateral margins more rounded; pronotum length 0.61–0.73 mm, width 1.04–1.15 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown; antennae milky white to pale yellowish brown; postclypeus and labrum pale yellow; thorax yellowish white; abdomen and legs whitish. Body length about 5.5–6.5 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long (length to mandibular base 1.50–1.55 mm, maximum width 1.75–1.80 mm). Fontanelle a circular translucent spot (diameter 0.15 mm). Compound eyes and ocelli indistinct. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3; segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 5 slightly shorter than segment 3. Postclypeus inflated and short, less than half as long as wide (length 0.30–0.35 mm, width 0.75–0.80 mm); divided into two halves by an incomplete dark line. Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped, anterior margin slightly or indistinctly concave, posterior margin nearly straight (length 0.55–0.60 mm, width 0.93–1.0 mm). Mesonotum narrower than pronotum, metanotum wider than pronotum; lateral margins of all three rounded.
